faq.q: What is a Collapsible Magnetic Rigid Box?
faq.a: A collapsible magnetic rigid box is a premium packaging box made from Kappa board (1.5–3mm) with four embedded magnets that allow the box to fold completely flat for storage and shipping, then assemble instantly into a rigid box with a secure magnetic closure. Roopac manufactures fully custom collapsible magnetic boxes from 100 pieces, with 3-week delivery from Tiruppur, India.

faq.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.a: 100 pieces, the same floor as every rigid box in our range.

faq.q: How long does delivery take?
faq.a: 3 weeks (21 working days) from artwork approval. Pan-India and international shipping available.

faq.q: How does the magnetic closure work?
faq.a: Four neodymium magnets are embedded inside the sleeve flap and tray edge during construction. When you close the box, the magnets align and snap shut — a clean, secure closure with no latch or ribbon needed.

faq.q: Can the box be stored flat?
faq.a: Yes. This is the only rigid box in our range that ships and stores completely flat. It reduces storage requirements by roughly 80% compared to pre-assembled rigid boxes like Lid & Bottom or Solid State.

faq.q: What sizes can I order?
faq.a: Fully custom — you specify the width, length, and height. There are no fixed sizes. We'll advise on optimal dimensions based on your product and board thickness.

faq.q: What finishing options are available?
faq.a: Matt lamination, Gloss lamination, Foil stamping (Gold, Silver, Rose Gold, etc.), and Spot UV. Inner and outer surfaces can have different finishes.

faq.q: How does this compare to other rigid boxes?
faq.a: The Collapsible Magnetic is the only rigid box that ships flat. Other rigid styles (Lid & Bottom, Neck & Shoulder, Solid State, Slider) offer different opening experiences but ship pre-assembled, which means higher freight and storage costs. If flat storage matters, this is the one.

faq.q: What products is it suitable for?
faq.a: Subscription boxes, luxury apparel, gift hampers, cosmetics kits, jewellery presentation, corporate gifting, and any premium product where the unboxing moment matters.

faq.q: What is a Regular Slotted Box (RSB)?
faq.a: A regular slotted box (RSB), also called an RSC (Regular Slotted Container), is the industry-standard shipping box — a single-piece corrugated carton where all four top and bottom flaps meet at the centre. faq.q: How is this different from a mailer box?
faq.a: The RSB is a flap-close box sealed with tape after packing — the classic shipping carton. A mailer box has a self-locking tuck flap designed to close without tape. Choose the RSB for bulk shipping and warehouse dispatch; choose the mailer for branded direct-to-customer delivery.

faq.a: Yes — single-colour screen printing or multicolour offset (CMYK, up to 4 colours); pick the print mode on the product page.

faq.q: What sizes are available?

faq.q: What is a Cotton Label for Clothing?
faq.a: A cotton label is a screen-printed or rotary-printed label made from 100% organic cotton fabric at 160 GSM, stitched into a garment's neckline, side seam, or hem. faq.q: What fold types are available for cotton labels?
faq.a: Six options: roll form (no fold, on a continuous roll), straight cut (individual pieces), end fold (one edge tucked under), center fold (folded in half along height), loop fold (creates a hanging loop), and meiter fold (both edges tucked under). The fold type affects open size and stitching method.

faq.q: Are cotton labels skin-friendly and wash-durable?
faq.a: Yes. The 100% organic cotton fabric is soft against skin -- no scratching, no irritation. Screen-printed or rotary-printed ink bonds into the fibre, so text stays legible through hundreds of wash cycles without cracking or fading.

faq.q: Can I use cotton labels for organic or sustainable clothing lines?
faq.a: Absolutely. 100% organic cotton labels pair naturally with organic, upcycled, and sustainability-focused garments. They're biodegradable and carry no synthetic components. Many Roopac customers use them specifically because their end customers check labels for material consistency.

faq.q: What's the difference between screen print and rotary print on cotton labels?
faq.a: Screen print is used for single-colour designs -- sharp, high-contrast, economical at scale. Rotary print handles two-colour designs with finer detail and smoother gradients. Both are wash-durable. Roopac picks the appropriate method based on your design -- you do not need to choose. Share your artwork and we will select the print method that gives the best result for your design complexity and colour count.

faq.a: Cotton size labels are screen-printed, single colour, soft against skin -- ideal for brands with organic or comfort-focused positioning. faq.q: Why do garment brands need dedicated size labels instead of printing size on the main label?

faq.q: What fold types are available for woven labels?
faq.a: End fold (one edge tucked under for sewing into a seam), rectangular cut (flat, no fold), loop fold (doubled for hanging from a seam), and centre fold (doubled, sewn at the fold). Loop and centre folds use double the material since the label folds over itself.
